st-pb-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of Punjab
st-pb-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Punjab, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-pb-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-pb-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-pb-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of Punjab
st-pb-panchayat-samitis.description: The intermediate (block) tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Punjab, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-pb-panchayat-samitis.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-pb-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-pb-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of Punjab
st-pb-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Punjab, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-pb-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-pb-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-pb-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Punjab
st-pb-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Punjab (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-pb-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-pb-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-pb-assembly.name: Punjab Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha)
st-pb-assembly.description: The unicameral state legislature of Punjab, 117 members elected by first-past-the-post from single-member constituencies for a 5-year term, meeting at the Palace of Assembly, Chandigarh. Currently the 16th Punjab Assembly, with an Aam Aadmi Party government.
st-pb-assembly.head: st-pb-pos-speaker

st-pb-dept-agriculture.name: Department of Agriculture
st-pb-dept-agriculture.description: Runs extension services, input subsidies and crop-support schemes for farmers and oversees agricultural policy and marketing infrastructure.

st-pb-dept-animal-husbandry-dairy-develo.name: Department of Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development and Fisheries
st-pb-dept-animal-husbandry-dairy-develo.description: Runs veterinary services, dairy development and livestock health programmes to support animal-owning farmers.

st-pb-dept-civil-aviation.name: Department of Civil Aviation
st-pb-dept-civil-aviation.description: Operates and licenses state-owned airstrips/heliports and coordinates air connectivity and VIP flight operations.

st-pb-dept-cooperation.name: Department of Cooperation
st-pb-dept-cooperation.description: Registers and regulates cooperative societies, including credit, marketing and sugar-mill cooperatives, and audits their finances.

st-pb-dept-defence-services-welfare.name: Department of Defence Services Welfare
st-pb-dept-defence-services-welfare.description: Runs welfare schemes, pensions and land/job reservations for ex-servicemen, war widows and their families.

st-pb-dept-elections.name: Department of Elections
st-pb-dept-elections.description: Conducts and administers state and local-body elections, prepares electoral rolls and enforces the model code of conduct in coordination with the Election Commission.

st-pb-dept-employment-generation-skill-d.name: Department of Employment Generation, Skill Development and Training
st-pb-dept-employment-generation-skill-d.description: Runs skill-development, apprenticeship and employment-exchange programmes to match jobseekers with jobs.

st-pb-dept-excise-and-taxation.name: Department of Excise and Taxation
st-pb-dept-excise-and-taxation.description: Collects state excise duty, VAT/GST and other indirect taxes, and licenses the liquor trade.

st-pb-dept-finance.name: Department of Finance
st-pb-dept-finance.description: Prepares the state budget, manages treasury and public debt, and controls government expenditure and pay/pension rules.

st-pb-dept-food-civil-supplies-and-consu.name: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs
st-pb-dept-food-civil-supplies-and-consu.description: Runs the public distribution system (ration shops), procures foodgrain and enforces consumer-protection and weights-and-measures law.

st-pb-dept-forest-and-wild-life-preserva.name: Department of Forest and Wild Life Preservation
st-pb-dept-forest-and-wild-life-preserva.description: Manages state forests and wildlife sanctuaries, enforces forest and wildlife protection law, and runs afforestation programmes.

st-pb-dept-general-administration.name: Department of General Administration
st-pb-dept-general-administration.description: Runs the secretariat's central administration, cadre management of officers, and coordination between departments.

st-pb-dept-health-and-family-welfare.name: Department of Health & Family Welfare
st-pb-dept-health-and-family-welfare.description: Runs maternal, child-health and family-planning programmes through the public health system.

st-pb-dept-higher-education-and-language.name: Department of Higher Education and Languages
st-pb-dept-higher-education-and-language.description: Administers government colleges and universities and funds/regulates higher and university education in the state.

st-pb-dept-home-affairs-and-justice.name: Department of Home Affairs and Justice
st-pb-dept-home-affairs-and-justice.description: Oversees the state police, prisons, home guards and internal-security administration, and handles law-and-order policy.

st-pb-dept-horticulture.name: Department of Horticulture
st-pb-dept-horticulture.description: Promotes fruit, vegetable and flower cultivation through extension services, subsidies and post-harvest infrastructure for farmers.

st-pb-dept-housing-and-urban-development.name: Department of Housing and Urban Development
st-pb-dept-housing-and-urban-development.description: Plans and funds urban infrastructure and municipal governance, and builds public housing through the state housing board.

st-pb-dept-industries-and-commerce.name: Department of Industries and Commerce
st-pb-dept-industries-and-commerce.description: Promotes industrial investment, runs industrial estates and administers incentives for MSMEs and large industry.

st-pb-dept-information-and-public-relati.name: Department of Information and Public Relation
st-pb-dept-information-and-public-relati.description: Runs the government's press, publicity and public-information machinery and manages official advertising.

st-pb-dept-promotion-of-information-tech.name: Department of Promotion of Information Technology Industry
st-pb-dept-promotion-of-information-tech.description: Drives e-governance, IT infrastructure and the promotion of the state's IT/ITeS industry.

st-pb-dept-investment-promotion.name: Department of Investment Promotion
st-pb-dept-investment-promotion.description: Single-window facilitation of new industrial and business investment into the state.

st-pb-dept-labour.name: Department of Labour
st-pb-dept-labour.description: Enforces labour law, registers factories/establishments, runs the Employees' State Insurance and welfare boards, and resolves industrial disputes.

st-pb-dept-legal-and-legislative-affairs.name: Department of Legal and Legislative Affairs
st-pb-dept-legal-and-legislative-affairs.description: Drafts state legislation, vets government contracts and rules, and runs the state's legal/prosecution machinery.

st-pb-dept-local-government.name: Department of Local Government
st-pb-dept-local-government.description: Oversees municipal corporations, councils and committees that run civic services in towns and cities.

st-pb-dept-medical-education-and-researc.name: Department of Medical Education and Research
st-pb-dept-medical-education-and-researc.description: Runs government medical, dental and nursing colleges and their attached teaching hospitals.

st-pb-dept-new-and-renewable-energy-sour.name: Department of New & Renewable Energy Sources
st-pb-dept-new-and-renewable-energy-sour.description: Promotes solar, wind and other renewable-energy generation and energy-efficiency programmes.

st-pb-dept-nri-affairs.name: Department of NRI Affairs
st-pb-dept-nri-affairs.description: Addresses the grievances of and liaises with the state's non-resident diaspora, including emigration and property issues.

st-pb-dept-parliamentary-affairs.name: Department of Parliamentary Affairs
st-pb-dept-parliamentary-affairs.description: Coordinates government business, bills and question-hour replies in the state legislature.

st-pb-dept-personnel.name: Department of Personnel
st-pb-dept-personnel.description: Handles recruitment rules, service matters, transfers and cadre management of state government employees.

st-pb-dept-planning.name: Department of Planning
st-pb-dept-planning.description: Prepares the state's development plans, allocates plan funds across departments and monitors scheme implementation.

st-pb-dept-power.name: Department of Power
st-pb-dept-power.description: Oversees electricity generation, transmission and distribution utilities and state power policy.

st-pb-dept-printing-and-stationery.name: Department of Printing and Stationery
st-pb-dept-printing-and-stationery.description: Runs government printing presses and supplies stationery and forms to government offices.

st-pb-dept-program-implementation.name: Department of Program Implementation
st-pb-dept-program-implementation.description: Monitors the physical and financial progress of government schemes and flagship programmes.

st-pb-dept-public-works.name: Department of Public Works
st-pb-dept-public-works.description: Builds and maintains government buildings, roads and bridges (Buildings & Roads).

st-pb-dept-revenue-rehabilitation-and-di.name: Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation & Disaster Management
st-pb-dept-revenue-rehabilitation-and-di.description: Maintains land records and land revenue administration through the district/tehsil machinery, and coordinates disaster relief and rehabilitation across the state.

st-pb-dept-rural-development-and-panchay.name: Department of Rural Development and Panchayat
st-pb-dept-rural-development-and-panchay.description: Funds and monitors rural infrastructure and livelihood schemes implemented through Panchayati Raj institutions.

st-pb-dept-school-education.name: Department of School Education
st-pb-dept-school-education.description: Runs government schools and administers the state's school curriculum, teacher recruitment and mid-day meal scheme.

st-pb-dept-science-technology-and-enviro.name: Department of Science, Technology & Environment
st-pb-dept-science-technology-and-enviro.description: Funds scientific research, technology promotion and pollution/environment regulation.

st-pb-dept-social-justice-empowerment-an.name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities
st-pb-dept-social-justice-empowerment-an.description: Runs welfare and scholarship schemes for Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes and minorities.

st-pb-dept-social-security-and-women-and.name: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development
st-pb-dept-social-security-and-women-and.description: Runs anganwadi/ICDS child-nutrition centres, women's welfare and child-protection schemes.

st-pb-dept-soil-and-water-conservation.name: Department of Soil & Water Conservation
st-pb-dept-soil-and-water-conservation.description: Runs watershed development and soil- and water-conservation works for agricultural land.

st-pb-dept-sports-and-youth-services.name: Department of Sports and Youth Services
st-pb-dept-sports-and-youth-services.description: Runs youth-development and volunteering programmes (e.g. NSS/NYKS coordination) alongside sports.

st-pb-dept-technical-education-and-indus.name: Department of Technical Education and Industrial Training
st-pb-dept-technical-education-and-indus.description: Runs polytechnics and regulates technical/engineering education in the state.

st-pb-dept-tourism-and-cultural-affairs.name: Department of Tourism and Cultural Affairs
st-pb-dept-tourism-and-cultural-affairs.description: Promotes the state's arts, language, heritage and cultural festivals.

st-pb-dept-transport.name: Department of Transport
st-pb-dept-transport.description: Regulates road transport, runs the state road transport corporation/undertaking and issues driving licences and vehicle registrations.

st-pb-dept-vigilance.name: Department of Vigilance
st-pb-dept-vigilance.description: Investigates corruption and misconduct by government officials and enforces integrity in public service.

st-pb-dept-water-resources.name: Department of Water Resources
st-pb-dept-water-resources.description: Builds and maintains irrigation canals, dams and river-water infrastructure.

st-pb-dept-water-supply-and-sanitation.name: Department of Water Supply and Sanitation
st-pb-dept-water-supply-and-sanitation.description: Provides piped drinking water and sanitation infrastructure, mainly in rural areas.

st-pb-dept-welfare-of-freedom-fighters.name: Department of Welfare of Freedom Fighters
st-pb-dept-welfare-of-freedom-fighters.description: Administers pensions and welfare benefits for freedom fighters and their families.

st-pb-dept-prisons-and-correctional-serv.name: Departments of Punjab Prisons and Correctional Services
st-pb-dept-prisons-and-correctional-serv.description: Runs the state's jails and correctional/rehabilitation services for prisoners.

st-pb-dept-food-processing.name: Department of Food Processing
st-pb-dept-food-processing.description: Promotes food-processing industry investment and agro-based industrial infrastructure.

st-pb-dept-mines-and-geology.name: Department of Mines and Geology
st-pb-dept-mines-and-geology.description: Regulates mining leases, mineral royalties and geological surveys in the state.

st-pb-council-of-ministers.name: Punjab Council of Ministers
st-pb-council-of-ministers.description: The Chief Minister and 15 cabinet ministers of the Aam Aadmi Party government of Punjab, collectively responsible to the Punjab Vidhan Sabha. Punjab currently has no Deputy Chief Minister.
st-pb-council-of-ministers.head: st-pb-pos-chief-minister

st-pb-sec.name: Punjab State Election Commission
st-pb-sec.description: Autonomous constitutional body that conducts elections to Panchayati Raj institutions and urban local bodies (municipal corporations, municipalities) in Punjab, and prepares/revises the electoral rolls for those bodies.
st-pb-sec.legalBasis: Article 243K and Article 243ZA of the Constitution
st-pb-sec.head: st-pb-pos-sec-commissioner

st-pb-psc.name: Punjab Public Service Commission
st-pb-psc.description: Constitutional body that conducts competitive examinations and interviews to recruit candidates for the Punjab Civil Service and other state government posts, and advises the state on service and promotion matters.
st-pb-psc.head: st-pb-pos-psc-chairman
